engineeringAgreement.meaning: Engineering judgment about TaskFlow state ownership plus one typed decision layer; not an evaluation metric or completion percentage

items.finding: Execution phase is read and written as TaskFlow state; no second active ledger.
Status and phase validate and commit through the same expected-revision CAS.
Prototype migration verifies matching owner, phase, revision and payload before dropping the old table.
Registry snapshots cannot overwrite phase-owned rows; deletes also filter execution_phase IS NULL.
User intent, assistant dispatch and real tool results flush before the next acknowledgement boundary.
Both lifecycle and execution writers must select taskflow.
The pending-effect CAS precedes existing tool execution and rejects a duplicate claimant.
Main-session recovery persists a stable run identity, boundary digest and finite attempt budget.
verified rows settle terminal; effect_pending/effect_committed rows retain the phase with reconciliation metadata and blocked status.
The reader validates the original hashed failure artifact and actual throw action.
Initial user-intent probes exclude background heartbeat turns.
Failures between repeated kill boundaries retain a failed observation and incomplete trial with unknown counters null.
The typed authority only records observations. Production continuation still consults the phase recovery planner; decision authority is not fully unified.
Shadow maps coarse transcript/delivery facts, not the complete committed execution-phase journal; the repeat observed a different deliver/reconcile choice.
Subagent/goal-wake/final-delivery/ACP do not query the shared authority. TF-0715 remains proposed.

unificationView: TaskFlow owns lifecycle/phase/revision writes; existing domain journals own effect truth; RecoveryAuthority should yield one admitted decision; receipts and event-log correlate evidence. Current integration only covers main-session/tool paths, and the authority remains shadow.
residualLimits: No general external-effect reconciliation executor or full atomic visibility across transcript/session/TaskFlow/domain effects.
The repeated baseline is incomplete and structurally variable; candidate absolute latency gates fail.
Full harness:ci exits 1 at stale unrelated Agent Dev evidence; focused green results do not establish GA.
